overallReport.summary: Riley performs best on average across both views and likes, making them the preferred host based on these metrics. While Riley also leads in total views and total likes, this is heavily influenced by their significantly higher upload volume compared to other hosts. Elijah produced the weakest results for average views, average likes, total views, and total likes. Linus and Elijah have much smaller sample sizes than Riley and James, which makes their specific rankings less reliable for long-term performance comparison.
